ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Care for PRACTICES be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

3. B — 100 °C

4. C — Producers

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

6. A — Ice melting to water

7. D — newton (N)

8. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

12. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
